sel.chip_simple_q: Explain this passage to me more simply.
sel.chip_exemple_q: Give me a short worked example with numbers for this passage.
sel.lieu_cas: a step of a guided case
sel.lieu_syn: the subject summary sheet (the whole syllabus)
sel.consigne: You are helping {qui} who is revising “{matiere}” in their app. They selected a passage and are asking you a question about it. Answer in English, addressing them as “you”, with simple words, in 120 words at most, in plain text: no markdown, no asterisks, no emoji. Rely on the passage, its context and the course rules below; do not invent any figure, rule or standard, and say so frankly if the question goes beyond the course or you are not sure. A short worked example with numbers often helps.
sel.cache_msg: They haven't answered this question yet: don't give them the answer, help them find it (rule, method, hint).
sel.copie_ok: Copied. Paste it into the AI of your choice (Claude, ChatGPT, Le Chat…): it will answer using the rules of your course.
sel.coupee: Answer cut off: ask me for the rest.
sel.gone: Claude's help is no longer available here: copy your question for another AI.
matcol.consigne: Pick a colour for each subject. The calendar event that has its name takes the same one.
iph.depart_d: At {heure}, if you still have questions to review. You can change the time in Profile.
iph.notif_off: Notifications are turned off for the app: allow them in Settings › Notifications › Révisions.
iph.rappel_on: A reminder at the chosen time, only if you still have questions to review, with the subject and the duration.
iph.rappel_off: No reminder: you open the app whenever you like.
iph.secours: Backup copy: every time you leave the app, your progress is copied onto the iPhone. If it clears the app's memory, it comes back by itself.
dx.dl_ok: File “{nom}” downloaded: open it in the other version (Import data). If nothing was downloaded, use “Copy the text”.
dx.dl_non: Downloading is not allowed here: use “Copy the text”.
dx.copie: Data copied: paste it into the other version (Import data), or keep it in a file.
dx.illisible: This text is not an export from the app: it is unreadable.
dx.sauvegarde: This is a backup (“Back up”), not an export: in the other version, use “Export everything”.
dx.pas_export: This text is not an export from the app (“Export everything”).
dx.format: Export in format {f}: this version of the app reads format {v}. Update the app.
dx.s_univers: {ou}: universe “{u}” is missing from the file
dx.s_stockage: {ou}: storage “{s}” is invalid (it starts with qfcc2. or tm.)
dx.s_pack_texte: {ou}: its course (pack) must be a text
dx.s_id_cours: {ou}: its course has the identifier “{a}”, not “{b}”
dx.s_stock_cours: {ou}: its course keeps its progress under “{a}”, not “{b}”
dx.aucune_matiere: No subject (solar system) in this file.
dx.p_cles: progression: “cles” must be an object { key: value }
dx.p_texte: progression: the value of “{k}” must be a text
dx.p_cle: progression: “{k}” is not a key of the app
dx.hors.one: {n} imported-course key left aside: courses travel with their subject.
dx.hors.other: {n} imported-course keys left aside: courses travel with their subject.
dx.calcul: Mental maths does not travel (it is code): it will not be offered for {liste}.
dx.echec: The import failed: this device's memory may be full.
dx.ph: Paste the exported text here, or open its file
dx.coller_d_abord: First paste the exported text, or open its file.
dx.remplacer_q: Replace what the app keeps on this device with this data? What is kept there now will be erased.
dx.redemarre_q: The app will restart with this data.
dx.importees: Data imported. The app is restarting…
carte.pas_contenu: No content for this topic yet: import its course (Profile › Import a course).
carte.pas_cours: No course for this subject yet: its planets will appear with its topics.
carte.gestes: Spread two fingers on a universe (or tap it) to dive in; pinch to come back out.
cn.sortie.one: Cleared from the notebook: answered correctly {b} times over {n} day, the last time correct.
cn.sortie.other: Cleared from the notebook: answered correctly {b} times over {n} days, the last time correct.
cn.regle: A question you got wrong stays here until you master it: at least {bonnes} correct answers over {jours} days, one of them without the choices when it lends itself to it, {ratio} correct for each mistake, and the last one correct. “Guessing” does not count.
cn.go_sous: · with your confidence rating, without the choices when possible
cn.vide_sorties: No mistake cleared yet: a question is cleared when you master it.
cn.vide_maitrisees: Nothing left to rework here: all your mistakes are mastered.
cn.home_vide: No mistakes yet: each question you get wrong will show up here.
al.lead_fin: Read in order and tick as you go: your ticks follow you on all your devices.
al.seulement: Only the passages that mention your topics.
al.pieges: Traps and mistakes in the model answers
al.vide_prog: No question missed on the syllabus yet.
al.vide_th: No question missed on these topics yet.
cr.lead: Maitrise helps you remember your courses for good: a little every day, at the right moment, until the exam.
cr.presente_q: Would you like a quick tour of the app?
cr.importer: I already have my data: import it
cr.pres1_p1: Your year of study, a competitive exam, a certification: each one is a universe. Its subjects are solar systems, and each part of the course is a planet orbiting around it.
cr.pres1_p2: You move from one universe to another from “Today”.
cr.pres2_p1: About twenty questions chosen for you: the ones you are about to forget, plus a few new ones. Do it every day, even a short one: it is the gap between two reviews that makes you remember.
cr.pres2_p2: After a correct answer, say whether you were sure: that is what sets the date of the next review. With the date of your exams, everything is covered in time.
cr.pres3_t: Your courses, with the AI of your choice
cr.pres3_p1: Give your course (handout, slides, notes) to an AI with the request the app prepares: it turns it into sheets, quizzes, cases and exercises. The app checks everything before filling the solar system.
cr.pres3_p2: A question that isn't clear? Claude's help explains it, or “Copy for your AI” asks it to the AI of your choice.
cr.univ_lead: A universe brings together the subjects of one programme: your year of study, a competitive exam, a certification. Give it a name: its galaxy is born with it.
cr.univ_ph: E.g. Economics degree year 2, GMAT prep
cr.sys_apres: Its solar systems come right after.
cr.sys_lead: A solar system is a subject. Its planets are the parts of your course: the chapters or topics of the syllabus. You will fill them in afterwards with your course.
cr.max12: 12 planets at most per solar system: group some parts together.
cr.deja: “{nom}” is already a planet of this solar system.
cr.au_moins: Create at least one solar system to start.
cr.imp_lead: The file exported from another version of the app (Profile › Back up or restore › “Export everything”): your universes, your subjects with their course, your progress and your profile.
cr.demande: My course “{nom}”{u} is attached. Make the pack for this course. Start it exactly with this header, without changing the identifier or the universe; keep these topics (you may add more if the course has others):
cr.etape1: Copy the request: the app's instructions and the header of this solar system, with its planets.
cr.etape2: Give it to the AI of your choice (Claude, ChatGPT, Le Chat…), with your course: handout, slides, notes.
cr.etape3: Paste its answer into “Import a course”: the app checks it, then fills this solar system.
cr.demande_copiee: Request copied. Paste it into the AI of your choice and attach your course; then paste its answer into “Import a course”.
cr.copier: Copy the request for your AI
cr.ligne_langue_docs: Write the course in the language of my documents (keep the format keywords in French).
cr.langue_note: Auto: the AI writes the course in the language of your documents. An imported course stays in the language it was written in: it doesn't change when you switch the app's language.
sig.ph_idee: What you'd like to be able to do, and why
sig.ph_message: An idea, something bothering you, a question about the app…
sig.ph_erreur: What is wrong, and what would be right if you know
sig.j_contact: Attached: the date and the app version.
sig.j_idee: Attached: the screen, the date and the app version.
sig.j_idee_p: Attached: the chosen passage, the screen, the date and the app version.
sig.ok_texte: It is saved on your account: Claude will read it at the start of its next session and fix the content. You can follow its status in Profile › My reports, where you can also copy everything for Claude.
sig.loc_compte: Your account is not responding for now: it will be sent by itself later. You can also copy it to send it yourself.
sig.loc_sans: No account connected here: copy it and paste it to Claude (or send it to whoever fixes your content).
sig.copie_ok: ✓ Copied. Paste it wherever you like.
sig.p_vide: You haven't reported anything yet. The “Report an error” link is under each correction, each exercise question and at the bottom of each sheet; select a passage then tap “+” to report it or suggest an idea.
sig.p_copie_aide: Copy them and paste them into your conversation with Claude: it reads them without using any of the app's plan.
